sources.title: Segformer-b2 Open-Source Semantic Segmentation Model - Free Deployment ...
sources.snippet: This is a PyTorch-implemented Segformer model designed for semantic segmentation tasks in urban street scenes. The model uses MIT-B2 as the encoder, trained at 1024x1024 resolution, suitable for fine-grained segmentation in urban scenarios.
